description: Austrian Highway Roadwork Views (AHRV) Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Felix Benjamin Oberhauser, Bertram Sabrowsky-Hirsch (RISC Software GmbH, 4232 Hagenberg, Austria). Austrian Highway Roadwork Views (AHRV) is a publicly available annotated dataset for object detection in highway roadwork environments. The dataset contains 1,812 scene images with 17,436 bounding-box annotations across 7 road entity classes. The dataset captures real-world variability of Austrian highway construction sites through multiple acquisition campaigns, camera systems, and recording conditions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
